items.reason: Red Leader's cost reduction counts only "each friendly Pilot unit and upgrade", so tokens (not Pilots) do not benefit it; its wide-board tag is not supported by its text. Its When-a-Pilot-attaches trigger makes tokens, but that is not a sac, count, or enter-play payoff.
Han Solo's epicAction says "When played as an upgrade: You may attack with attached unit." Trask Walker's text is "When Played/On Attack", so the extra attack fires its On Attack.

Milodon Rider's "When Played: You may return another friendly non-leader unit to its owner's hand" can return Grand Army Marine, and replaying it triggers its "When Played: Give a Shield token to a friendly Gungan unit."

Evil is Everywhere says "Defeat a unit with cost equal to or less than the number of Villainy aspect icons among friendly units." The target is any unit, not necessarily your own, so the sac-fodder want "defeats your own units" is not in the text. Spy tokens also add no Villainy icons.

Secretive Sage has the printed trait Force. The Burden of Masters says "Put a Force unit from your discard pile on the bottom of your deck," so a Force trait in the discard pile is what it references.
Let's Call It War says "Deal 3 damage to a unit," which can target your own unit. Lando Calrissian has Grit, and damage on Lando switches Grit on.

The Burden of Masters says "give 2 Experience tokens to it" to a unit played from hand, and the row rule counts Experience as an upgrade. Peppi Bow's "While this unit is upgraded, she gets +1/+1" then applies.

Darth Sidious says "defeat each non-Sith unit with 3 or less remaining HP." Jedi In Hiding is a non-Sith unit with 3 HP, so its "When Defeated" triggers. The Force-token use in both cards is optional.
Chewbacca's action says "Attack with a unit, even if it's exhausted." Darth Vader's deployBox says "On Attack: Discard any number of cards...", so an attack by Vader fires its On Attack.

Sweep the Area says "Return up to 2 non-leader units in the same arena with a combined cost 3 or less to their owners' hands." Syndicate Spice Runner costs 2 and can be one of your own units, and replaying it triggers "When Played: Search the top 3 cards..."

Stronger Together says "Create 2 Mandalorian tokens." Obi-Wan Kenobi says "While you control 7 or more units, their printed power is considered to be 7," so tokens count toward the wide-board threshold.
Emissary's Sheathipede has the printed trait Vehicle. Captain Tarkin says "Each friendly Vehicle unit gets +1/+0 and gains Overwhelm."

Tempest Assault says "deal 2 damage to each enemy space unit" only if you dealt damage to an enemy base this phase. That damage defeats only units with 2 or fewer remaining HP, so it is not removal and does not reliably trigger Bo-Katan's "When an enemy unit is defeated."
Industrious Team says "When Played: You may defeat a non-leader unit with 4 or less remaining HP." Reanimated Night Trooper has 2 HP and "When Defeated: Look at the top card of a deck."

Baylan Skoll says "return a non-leader unit that costs 4 or less to its owner's hand." Profiteering Hunter costs 1, and replaying it triggers "When Played: Another friendly unit gets +1/+1 for this phase."
Mystic Monastery says "The Force is with you (create your Force token)." Eighth Brother says "You may use the Force (lose your Force token)" in its When you play another unit ability.

Krrsantan's text says "Return this unit to your hand (from play)," so it returns only itself and cannot return War Juggernaut. Krrsantan has no When Played ability, so there is nothing to replay for the benefit.
Pounce says "Attack with a Creature unit. It gets +4/+0 for this attack." Drengir Spawn is a Creature, and its text "When this unit attacks and defeats a unit" fires on that attack.

Arihnda Pryce says "You may defeat another friendly unit," which puts that unit in your discard pile. Blade of Talzin says "return this upgrade from your discard pile to your hand" if it was on a friendly Night unit.

Catch the Scent says "Create 2 Beast tokens and ready 1 of them," so it readies only the new Beast tokens and not 0-0-0. Also, 0-0-0's wants (extra-attacks, cards-in-discard) are not matched by an offer from Catch the Scent.
Governor's Shuttle says "Each player chooses a unit they control. Defeat those units." You can choose Skyway Cloud Car, and its "When Defeated: You may return a non-leader unit..." then triggers.

Vader's epicAction says "Attached unit gains: On Attack: You may deal 1 damage to a unit," which can hit Arena Nexu itself to switch on its Grit. The inline text does not say whether Piloting can attach to a Creature such as Arena Nexu, and that decides whether the pair works.
Focus Fire says "Choose a unit," which can make a damaged unit. Red Five says "On Attack: You may deal 2 damage to a damaged unit," so the damage gives it a target.
Supporting Eta-2 has the printed trait Vehicle. Echo Base Engineer says "You may give a Shield token to a damaged Vehicle unit," which references that trait.

Iden Versio's text has only Shielded and a Piloting epicAction that triggers "When this upgrade attaches to a unit." That trigger does not depend on existing upgrades, so a Shield from Covering the Wing gives no benefit to Iden.
